name: Contour: fitted to the incoming body
description: Fit the outfit closely to the body in the incoming image, following her contour at the bust, waist, hips and legs unless this prompt says otherwise: the garment supports and lifts the bust like a well-made structured bodice or a push-up, shaping it into a full, firm, rounded form with a crisp, clearly defined cleavage at the centre, so the bust is never hidden, flattened or lost behind loose fabric; the waist is defined and the hips follow their natural curve, as a real fitted garment on her body would.
notes: Optional line (components.body_contour). The outfit shows her real shape and a lifted, supported bust instead of hanging loose.
